title: Oven-Baked Mushroom Stroganoff Rice
ingredients: parsley leaves, finely chopped, to serve
method: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.

Spray an ovenproof dish with low-calorie cooking spray. Add the onion, garlic, mushrooms, smoked paprika, onion granules and thyme. Spray with more cooking spray, mix well and spread out evenly. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven, add the rice, hot stock, Worcestershire sauce and tomato purée. Stir everything together, cover tightly with foil and return to the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil, stir, then return to the oven (without foil) for 5 minutes.
Season, stir through the crème fraîche and serve scattered with parsley.
notes: Add beef strips or chicken thigh fillets in step 2 with the vegetables for a non-vegetarian version.
